content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

At first glance, options like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, or Paddle might seem like the obvious choice for creators in restricted countries. However, a closer look reveals that these platforms charge hefty fees, ranging from 3.5% to 15% per sale. In contrast, NOWPayments, a no-KYC payment gateway, charges a mere 0.5% fee, making it an attractive alternative for creators who want to retain more of their hard-earned revenue. But what about the infrastructure itself? How do these options stack up in terms of delivery, automation, and ownership?
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, most payment gateways and platforms will either reject transactions or force you to jump through hoops to comply with their KYC requirements. NOWPayments, on the other hand, takes a different approach. By leveraging cryptocurrencies like BSC, Solana, or TRON, NOWPayments allows creators to accept payments from anywhere in the world, without the need for KYC or any other form of identification. This makes it the perfect solution for creators who want to reach a global audience without the hassle of restrictive regulations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

One of the biggest advantages of NOWPayments is its lightning-fast payment processing speed. Transactions are settled in real-time, ensuring that creators get paid quickly and efficiently. When it comes to fees, NOWPayments is also the clear winner, charging a mere 0.5% fee per sale, compared to the 10% charged by Gumroad. Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

By using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, creators can automate their delivery process, ensuring that customers receive their digital products instantly. And with NOWPayments, creators retain full ownership of their products and data, without any middlemen or intermediaries to worry about. This means that creators can focus on what they do best – creating amazing digital products that delight their customers.
